7.2 Handling multiple networks and drivers
Usually only one LIN driver module (supporting multiple networks) is needed in an ECU to handle all LIN networks. However, rarely, some hardware configurations the ECU contain different LIN hardware (e.g. an advanced LIN controller and a UART). In such case, more than one different LIN drivers are required. This will not affect the Lin SM module since the LIN driver only interfaces the LinIf module and not the LIN driver module directly. The LinSM will only handle networks, and is not concerned to which driver the network maps to, this will be handled by the LinIf.
